'''Hatabbas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. He kept a pet [[Svaper/Legends|svaper]] in his lair, and he let it loose on those who refused to repay debts to him or angered him other ways.
